pr_summary: Fix librosa API compatibility issues in MLCommons inference RNNT speech recognition benchmark. Recent librosa versions changed function signatures requiring keyword arguments (sr=, orig_sr=, target_sr=, top_db=, n_fft=) instead of positional arguments. Also fixes torch.stft return_complex handling and numpy array dtype for coco.py.
environment_management: Python virtualenv (python3-venv) located at /home/ubuntu/python3-venv. No conda required - the project specifically avoids conda for AArch64 systems.
special_system_dependencies: AArch64 architecture required for Docker builds
patch_file_cues: speech_recognition/rnnt/pytorch/parts/features.py - librosa.filters.mel() signature change (sr=, n_fft= keyword args)
test_file_cues: vision/classification_and_detection - image classification and object detection
Examples in docker/pytorch-aarch64/examples/ serve as integration tests
platform_constraint_evidence: docker/pytorch-aarch64/Dockerfile explicitly checks: RUN if ! [ "$(arch)" = "aarch64" ] ; then exit 1;
docker/pytorch-aarch64/README.md states: 'Confirm the machine is AArch64, other architectures are not supported'
Shell scripts use bash (#!/bin/bash) with Linux-specific paths (/home/ubuntu/python3-venv)
No Windows-only or macOS-only dependencies detected
notes: This is a MLCommons inference benchmark repository with ARM-specific optimizations. The fix.patch modifies the mlcommons_rnnt.patch file which is applied to the MLCommons inference repository during Docker build. The actual source files (features.py, segment.py, coco.py) are in the external MLCommons inference repository (github.com/mlcommons/inference), not directly in this repository. The patch file contains the fixes that will be applied to those external files. The project uses pip for Python package management with librosa==0.10.0 pinned in the Dockerfile. Platform is Linux/AArch64 - the Docker build explicitly requires aarch64 architecture.
